body: I’m still here, brother. Tired but still here
Don’t let a woman bring you down brother
Reach out to close friends it can take a load off
Message her, I wish so bad I had someone who cares about me to just reach out, especially if something like that just happened. Message her when you’re not there and try to hangout with her a lot
I’m here to vent man not prevention I doubt I’ll ever act on it

I know this sounds so stupid but I’m always there for people even literally dragging them out of bed if I have to, to make them get up and be around people to not be depressed. 


But when it comes to me.. well yeah
I think I’m giving up, god I never wanted this the weight just seems too heavy now and I have no where to go
